admin_login.findings: Basic auth check and role verification present in admin.html init().

dashboard_stats.findings: Route exists, but lacks granular filtering. Promise.all is fragile if one collection is empty or fails.

add_question.findings: Form exists in HTML, but JavaScript submission logic (onSubmit) is completely missing from AdminPanel object in admin.html.

edit_question.findings: Edit buttons missing from question list table. Save logic missing from frontend. Route exists in backend.

delete_question.findings: Implemented in both frontend and backend.

bulk_upload.findings: Backend route exists, but no UI components or logic in admin.html.

subject_analytics.findings: No subject-specific performance or growth data implemented beyond global activity chart.

user_management.findings: Listing and Ban/Unban logic implemented and verified.

payment_records.findings: Basic listing and revenue calculation implemented.

live_session_management.findings: Completely missing from both frontend and backend.

question_search.findings: Backend supports regex search, but no search input exists in the questions section of admin.html.

topic_filtering.findings: Backend supports it, but frontend UI lacks topic selection/filtering dropdowns.

critical_dom_errors: admin.html: questionForm has no event listener to handle submit.
admin.html: questionsTableBody only renders 'Del' action, 'Edit' is missing.
api_inconsistencies: /api/admin/stats returns plain objects for users/tests while other routes return arrays.
Error handling in admin.js returns generic 500 without trace logging in most routes.
